page.title: My household
page.subtitle: Share your stock with other accounts by inviting them to your household.

card.qrCodeHint: Scanning it joins this household directly (after signing in if needed).

create.title: Create a new household
create.description: Create a shared household and invite other accounts to join it.

join.title: Join a household
join.description: Enter the invite code provided by the household admin.

transferDialog.title: Transfer your stock to this new household?
transferDialog.descriptionBefore: Your products, categories, locations and shopping list currently in
transferDialog.descriptionAfter: can be moved to this new household as soon as it's created. This action is reversible by creating a new transfer later, but it moves all current stock immediately. If you transfer, you won't be asked about default categories/locations afterwards (the transfer already brings your own).

deleteDialog.title: Delete this household?
deleteDialog.description: This will permanently delete the household "{{name}}", all its stock (products, categories, locations, shopping list) and remove all its members. This action is irreversible.

defaultsDialog.title: Create default categories and locations?
defaultsDialog.description: You can start this household with a ready-to-use set of categories (Food, Beverages, Hygiene...) and locations (Kitchen, Fridge...), or start with an empty household.

toast.transferSuccess: Stock transferred: switch to this household to see it
